sectors.name: Web Development
sectors.overview: Learn to build accessible, responsive, interactive, full-stack web applications.

steps.title: Internet & Web Fundamentals
steps.learning_outcome: Understand how a browser communicates with servers and how websites are delivered.

steps.title: HTML
steps.learning_outcome: Create well-structured accessible web pages.

steps.title: CSS
steps.learning_outcome: Create responsive layouts that work across screen sizes.

steps.title: JavaScript
steps.learning_outcome: Build interactive browser applications and consume APIs.

steps.title: Frontend & Backend
steps.learning_outcome: Build a complete client-server application.

steps.title: Database & Deployment
steps.learning_outcome: Deploy a production-style full-stack application.

sectors.final_project: Build a full-stack CSE learning platform with authentication, search, progress tracking, database, admin panel and deployment.

sectors.name: Software Engineering
sectors.overview: Learn the engineering process for designing, building, testing, deploying and maintaining reliable software.

steps.title: Programming Foundations
steps.learning_outcome: Write readable programs and solve small problems.

steps.title: DSA
steps.learning_outcome: Choose suitable data structures and reason about algorithm complexity.

steps.title: OOP & Clean Code
steps.learning_outcome: Design maintainable object-oriented and modular code.

steps.title: Software Development Process
steps.learning_outcome: Work effectively on software as part of a team.

steps.title: Testing & Architecture
steps.learning_outcome: Build software that can be tested and evolved safely.

steps.title: System Design
steps.learning_outcome: Design systems from requirements to deployable architecture.

sectors.final_project: Design and implement a production-style multi-user application with tests, CI, documentation, monitoring and a system-design document.

sectors.name: App Development
sectors.overview: Learn to design, build, test and publish mobile applications.

steps.title: Programming & Mobile Concepts
steps.learning_outcome: Understand the language and constraints of mobile development.

steps.title: UI Development
steps.learning_outcome: Build clean multi-screen mobile interfaces.

steps.title: State & Local Storage
steps.learning_outcome: Create apps that preserve and manage local data.

steps.title: APIs & Authentication

steps.title: Advanced Mobile
steps.learning_outcome: Use real device capabilities and optimize applications.

steps.title: Testing & Publishing
steps.learning_outcome: Prepare a mobile app for real users.

sectors.final_project: Build a complete mobile app with authentication, API integration, local caching, notifications and a release build.

sectors.name: AI & Machine Learning
sectors.overview: Learn the mathematical, programming and practical foundations required to build and deploy machine-learning systems.

steps.title: Python & Data Foundations
steps.learning_outcome: Manipulate datasets and write reusable Python programs.

steps.title: Mathematics & Statistics
steps.learning_outcome: Understand the math behind common ML algorithms.

steps.title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
steps.learning_outcome: Train, compare and evaluate classical ML models.

steps.title: Model Evaluation
steps.learning_outcome: Select models based on meaningful evaluation rather than a single score.

steps.title: Deep Learning
steps.learning_outcome: Build neural-network solutions for practical problems.

steps.title: ML Engineering
steps.learning_outcome: Turn a trained model into a usable service.

sectors.final_project: Build an end-to-end ML system: dataset → preprocessing → training → evaluation → API → simple UI → deployment.

sectors.name: Data Science
sectors.overview: Learn to collect, clean, analyze, visualize and model data to answer real-world questions.

steps.title: Python for Data
steps.learning_outcome: Load, transform and inspect datasets.

steps.title: SQL
steps.learning_outcome: Query relational data confidently.

steps.title: Statistics
steps.learning_outcome: Use statistics to reason about data and uncertainty.

steps.learning_outcome: Turn raw data into understandable insights.

steps.title: Machine Learning
steps.learning_outcome: Build predictive models when analysis requires them.

steps.title: Portfolio & Communication
steps.learning_outcome: Communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

sectors.final_project: Analyze a real public dataset, build an interactive dashboard, write a data story and optionally create a predictive model.

sectors.name: Cyber Security
sectors.overview: Learn defensive security, networking, operating systems, application security, incident response and ethical testing.

steps.title: Computing & Networking
steps.learning_outcome: Understand how systems communicate and where attacks can occur.

steps.title: Linux & Scripting
steps.learning_outcome: Operate and automate security tasks on Linux.

steps.title: Security Fundamentals
steps.learning_outcome: Assess security problems using correct terminology and models.
projects: Threat model for a web app

steps.title: Web & Application Security
steps.learning_outcome: Identify and prevent common application vulnerabilities.

steps.title: Defensive Security
steps.learning_outcome: Detect, investigate and respond to security incidents.

steps.title: Ethical Testing
steps.learning_outcome: Perform authorized security assessments and communicate findings responsibly.

sectors.final_project: Create an isolated security lab, harden a deliberately vulnerable application, document findings and produce a professional remediation report.

sectors.name: Cloud Computing
sectors.overview: Learn cloud architecture, compute, storage, networking, security, automation and scalable deployment.

steps.title: Reliability & Security
steps.learning_outcome: Design safer and more resilient cloud systems.

sectors.final_project: Deploy a secure full-stack application using managed services, infrastructure as code, monitoring and backups.

sectors.name: DevOps
sectors.overview: Learn the practices and tools used to build, test, deploy, observe and operate software reliably.

steps.learning_outcome: Operate systems using measurable reliability goals.

sectors.final_project: Create a CI/CD pipeline that builds, tests, containerizes and deploys an application to Kubernetes with monitoring.

sectors.name: Database Engineering
